verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence touching data portability is the Files API, which lets you download an agent's disk over HTTP even while the agent sleeps. Agents are also plain Docker images under a three-endpoint contract, so workloads aren't locked to proprietary formats. There is no documented account-wide export or exit path, and the migration docs cover moving onto Maritime, not off it. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export (agents, configuration/variables, session logs, triggers, channel data), stated open export formats, an off-boarding/leave workflow, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Maritime Files API: eight endpoints and both SDKs to browse, upload, download, and edit an agent's disk over HTTP, even while the agent sleeps.
Any Docker container becomes an agent: three endpoints get you sleep/wake, channels, and triggers.
